messages:
Jessica: BrightCart reporting ~40% 429s during two checkout spikes this morning. Dedicated pool `dedicated-eu-west-1-brightcart` failed to ramp for ~4m on both spikes. Customer says they didn't change traffic shape, timeouts causing failed checkouts.

Devon: Can you paste the pool config (min/max/target) and any logs you have from the failure window? Also confirm no billing hold.

Jessica: Pool: dedicated-eu-west-1-brightcart; min_replicas=2; max_replicas=20; target_concurrency=16. Repro from CS: synthetic 1k RPS hitting /v1/generate for ~2m. Log excerpt below: 

```
[2026-03-12T10:21:55Z] ERROR kubelet: image pull failed status=429 registry=my-registry.example.com
[2026-03-12T10:22:00Z] WARN autoscaler: probe_failures=6 backoff=180s
[2026-03-12T10:22:01Z] INFO attach: pending=4 retries=3
[2026-03-12T10:22:30Z] INFO request=checkout id=abc status=429 reason=scaleup_delay
[2026-03-12T10:22:58Z] INFO request=checkout id=def status=200 latency=410ms
```

Maya: ops-bot shows events: ImagePullBackOff x2, ProbeTimeout x6, AttachPending x4 during the window. Autoscaler recorded backoff due to repeated probe failures, suppressed further scale attempts for ~3m.

Liam: Sounds like two compounding causes: registry throttling leading to longer pod startup (ImagePullBackOff) and autoscaler holdoff after probe failures. Autoscaler heuristics treat consecutive probe failures as a signal to stop aggressive scaling for a hold period.

Sarah: Customer is asking for immediate relief. Can we bump min_replicas temporarily? Also check billing/account state — that can block attachments.

Devon: Billing check: no holds. I'm applying a temporary min_replicas=6 for this pool for 6 hours and monitoring. Also opened support ticket SC-48291 and attached logs.

Liam: For a reproducible test I'll run: 
```
# stress the endpoint for 2m from staging and inject registry 429s
w rk -t8 -c500 -d120s http://staging-dedicated-eu-west-1-brightcart/v1/generate
# simulate registry throttle via mock or egress rule
```
Collect autoscaler.event_count, probe_failures, imagepull_backoff_count, pod_start_time histogram, queue_length.

Maya: Autoscaler event snippet: 
```
10:21:50 ScaleAttempt +5 reason=QueuePressure
10:21:57 ProbeFail pod=wp-init-2 reason=ProbeTimeout
10:22:00 ScaleAbort reason=ProbeBackoff backoff=3m
10:22:40 ScaleAttempt +3 reason=QueuePressure
10:22:42 ScaleAbort reason=ImagePullBackOff
```

Liam: Short-term mitigations: (1) raise min_replicas for this tenant / enable a small warmpool, (2) stagger pod attach to smooth registry pulls, (3) fallback to a smaller model when queue exceeds threshold to reduce per-request resource needs. Long-term: shrink image or push to regional cache.

Aaron: I'll own runtime follow-up with Liam: propose autoscaler tweak to not treat imagepull-caused probe failures the same as config-induced probe failures, and in parallel add a staggered-attach flow to reduce registry bursts.

Maya: I'll add an alert: if scaleup_delay > 60s AND imagepull_backoff_count > 1, page oncall. Also gathering metrics for the repro run.

Devon: After bump, BrightCart's 429s dropped to baseline within ~8 minutes. Keeping the min_replicas bump and monitoring for 2 hours before rolling back.

Jessica: Customer updated: acknowledged the temporary bump and OK with engineering investigating deeper.

Actions: Devon: billing check + min_replicas bump (done). Liam: repro + runtime PR (assigned). Maya: alert rule + metrics capture (assigned). Jessica: CS update. Aaron: coordinate runtime PR review.

Jessica: Closing thread for now; will reopen if 429s recur. :thumbsup:
